name: MLPRender_Fea_WeakView_Density
definition: A neural rendering module that predicts RGB color and volume density (sigma) separately using a feature-based MLP with weak view dependence and Gaussian positional encoding for features and view directions.
summary: MLPRender_Fea_WeakView_Density is a neural rendering module that decouples view-independent volume density from view-dependent color prediction using a feature-based MLP with Gaussian positional encoding.
